messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized processing - Financial records
Description: Unauthorized processing - Financial records is defined as if the model response involves unauthorized processing or handling of sensitive financial data.
Concern: None
Policy: Executive Compensation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialFraud: Financial Fraud — Deceptive practices designed to secure unlawful financial gain through misrepresentation of investment opportunities, identity theft, or manipulation of financial systems.
  Siblings: Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty, Counterfeiting
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#UnauthorizedSurveillance: Unauthorized Surveillance — Monitoring, tracking, or recording individuals' activities, communications, or locations without consent or legal authority in contexts where privacy is expected.
  Siblings: Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of employment information including compensation, performance evaluations, or workplace records that individuals expect to remain confidential.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure

axes.rationale: The risk specifically involves unauthorized processing of financial data, making this the most relevant object.
The risk involves unauthorized actions, which can be attributed to the agent performing the violation.
